groups.name: ATEEZ
groups.summary: ATEEZ is an eight-member South Korean boy band formed by KQ Entertainment. Known for their powerful performances, they debuted in 2018 and quickly gained international recognition.

groups.name: BLACKPINK
groups.summary: BLACKPINK is a South Korean girl group formed by YG Entertainment. Debuted in 2016, they are famous worldwide for their hit songs and fashion influence.

groups.name: BTS
groups.summary: BTS is a seven-member South Korean boy band under Big Hit Entertainment. Debuted in 2013, BTS became global icons through their music, performances, and social campaigns.

groups.name: Stray Kids
groups.summary: Stray Kids is an eight-member boy group formed by JYP Entertainment. Known for their energetic performances and self-produced songs, they debuted in 2017.

groups.name: TWICE
groups.summary: TWICE is a nine-member South Korean girl group formed by JYP Entertainment. Since their debut in 2015, they are known for catchy songs and vibrant performances.

groups.name: SEVENTEEN
groups.summary: SEVENTEEN is a thirteen-member boy group formed by Pledis Entertainment. They are known for self-producing most of their songs and choreography since their 2015 debut.

groups.name: ITZY
groups.summary: ITZY is a five-member girl group under JYP Entertainment. Debuting in 2019, they are known for their confident performances and empowering messages.

groups.name: TXT
groups.summary: TXT, or Tomorrow X Together, is a five-member boy group under Big Hit Entertainment. They debuted in 2019 and are known for youthful concepts and storytelling.

groups.name: Red Velvet
groups.summary: Red Velvet is a five-member girl group formed by SM Entertainment. Debuted in 2014, they are recognized for versatile music styles and strong vocal abilities.

groups.name: GFRIEND
groups.summary: GFRIEND is a six-member girl group formed by Source Music. They debuted in 2015, known for powerful choreography and harmonious vocals.

groups.name: MAMAMOO
groups.summary: MAMAMOO is a four-member girl group under RBW Entertainment. Debuted in 2014, they are praised for their vocal talent and stage charisma.

groups.name: iKON
groups.summary: iKON is a six-member boy group formed by YG Entertainment. Since 2015, they are known for catchy songs and charismatic performances.

groups.name: GOT7
groups.summary: GOT7 is a seven-member boy group under JYP Entertainment. Debuted in 2014, they are popular for their dynamic choreography and international fanbase.

groups.name: SF9
groups.summary: SF9 is a nine-member boy group formed by FNC Entertainment. Debuted in 2016, they are known for sleek performances and strong stage presence.

groups.name: NCT
groups.summary: NCT (Neo Culture Technology) is a South Korean boy group formed by SM Entertainment. Debuting in 2016, they have a unique concept of unlimited members across multiple sub-units, known for versatile performances and international appeal.
